scientific_integrity: Exact stationary derivations and Gaussian response identity. Finite simulations are corroboration, not proof. Historical priority has residual general-linear-cocycle risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for two patches, symmetric migration and independent equal-variance OU environments; does not locate or prove uniqueness of optimum or extend to all finite patch numbers.
title: A sharp colored-noise growth ceiling and finite optimal dispersal in two ecological patches
